profile.name: RPLIDAR 二维激光雷达
profile.description: 用于获取周围环境二维距离与角度扫描数据的旋转式激光雷达。该设备可连续输出测距点，形成一圈扫描缓冲区，常用于机器人避障、环境感知、建图与定位实验。
profile.description_en: A rotating 2D LiDAR used to acquire distance-and-angle scan data of the surrounding environment. It continuously outputs range measurements and maintains a recent full-scan buffer, making it suitable for robotics experiments involving obstacle avoidance, perception, mapping, and localization.

registry.name: SLAMTEC Adapted from https://github.com/Ezward/rplidar
registry.description: RP Lidar2是由SLAMTEC生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括初始化、扫描、绘图、读取数据、运行。支持Signal, Slot, angle in bounds等操作。
